title: RISK: Class A (10.x) support in Central US for the agent subnet is contradicted between sources
description: Learn 'Supported regions' table (ms.date 2026-08-20) lists Central US Class A = Yes and states Class A is supported in every region where Agent Service is available. But the official 15b BYO-VNet sample README lists a FIXED subset that OMITS Central US: Australia East, Brazil South, Canada East, East US, East US 2, France Central, Germany West Central, Italy North, Japan East, South Africa North, South Central US, South India, Spain Central, Sweden Central, UAE North, UK South, West US, West US 3. Learn troubleshooting also documents the real error: 'Provided subnet must be of the proper address space. Please provide a subnet which has address space in the range of 172 or 192.' Failure mode is expensive - it surfaces at capability host creation, after Foundry is deployed. MITIGATION: add 172.16.0.0/16 as a second address space on vnet-fwf-cus and move snet-agent to 172.16.0.0/24 while the subnet is still empty. Cheap now, painful later.
